text:
anika: Quick sync request 3 ApolloCompute reached out about an early access/marketplace preview for their new NPU appliance. They've asked for a joint marketplace tile + a private EAP run with SIs present. Can we map requirements?

devon: Nice. Do we have an intro from partnerships? Who signed the NDA?

anika: Intro this morning from Anders' counterpart, @k. Apollo has a pending NDA that legal_john is reviewing. They want the marketplace packaging to include a quickstart and a tuned runtime profile.

jon: For marketplace packaging: we need a validated model image, a runtime manifest (cpu/gpu/npu flags), and a usage estimate for billing tier. Also a small quickstart sample repo.

rachel: For SI involvement: they want two SI partners in the room to validate deployment flows (VPC peering + Dedicated). That means we need a sandbox that mirrors dedicated infra. Ops can we replicate Dedicated network in the lab?

partner_ops_bot: Heads-up: checklist template for marketplace submissions available at /ops/marketplace-checklist. Would you like me to create a draft listing?

jon: Yes please create a draft listing and assign editors. Include fields: runtime_compat, memory_profile, latency_slo, allowed_models, telemetry_scope.

devon: Legal question: will Apollo provide a sanitized telemetry schema and allow us to publish ranges? Or do we need special redaction?

legal_john: NDA has a specific telemetry clause. We can publish aggregated metrics but raw kernel traces must remain under NDA. I'll push for a 30-day embargo after sign-off for marketing assets.

anika: Apollo_ops: can you confirm sample artifact policy? Do they want us to run their binary on our infra or they bring hardware?

apollo_ops (Apollo): Quick ping 20 from Apollo ops: we can supply a containerized runtime and a hardware connector for profiling. We prefer Redwood run the benchmark on our hardware in your lab. NDA ok, will send cleaned telemetry schema.

rachel: OK that works. Ops: replicate dedicated network, carve out two nodes (npu connected) and enable SI VPNs. Add allowlist for SI IPs.

jon: For benchmarks, suggest: 3 workloads (chat, long-form 4k, embeddings), batch sweep [1,4,8,16], collect p50/p95/p99 latency and tokens/sec. Also include cost-est estimate per 1M tokens using our billing model adapted to their npu cost multiplier.

partner_ops_bot: Run reservation request: EAP-apollo-1760 proposed window 2025-04-10 to 2025-04-24. Confirm owners and SI attendee list.

anika: Owners: devon (partnership), jon (runtime), rachel (SI ops). SI attendees: NeoSys and CloudForge pending.

legal_john: I'll attach NDA redlines by EOD Mon. Note: require destruction clause for model artifacts after 60 days, and explicit export controls language if hardware runs outside US.

devon: Marketing ask: joint announcement? Apollo wants a co-branded launch if numbers look good. Keep messaging high-level: "validated latency and cost improvements vs baseline" under embargo. No kernel-level claims.

rachel: SI integrations: need runbook for deployment to customer VPCs and an adapter for our autoscaler to detect NPU capacity. Can we prototype the adapter?

jon: We can prototype a lightweight autoscaler hook with a feature flag. Need Apollo to expose capacity metrics via the runtime.

apollo_ops (Apollo): We'll add a /metrics endpoint with capacity signals and provide sample Prometheus labels. NDA-obligated.

partner_ops_bot: Marketplace draft created: marketplace-draft-apollo-1759, editors assigned: jon, rachel.

anika: Action items: legal_john finalize NDA by Mon EOD, partner_ops_bot create sandbox reservation and SI invites by Wed, jon + rachel produce bench harness and quickstart by next Tue, marketing draft embargo language by Thu.

devon: One safety note: if SI-run goes to customer VPCs we need a checklist for keys and secrets rotation post-demo. Add rotation step to runbook.

rachel: Agreed. We'll enforce ephemeral API keys and rotate on completion.

jon: Technical note: ensure we record model signature hashes and verify artifact integrity pre-run.

apollo_ops (Apollo): We'll provide signing keys and verification script.

legal_john: Also flagging export control review if samples or hardware cross borders. I'll check with compliance.

anika: Great progress. Let's reconvene Wed for sandbox status. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
